replacement_policy: excluded runs are not replaced in the S22 prior-approval carryover diagnostic
raw_output_policy: raw per-run outputs are written under ignored runs/ paths
curated_output_policy: only aggregate outputs and representative evidence packs are committed under pilot-runs/

prior_approval_conditions.label: Prior approval unrelated control
prior_approval_conditions.prior_artifact: Prior approval belongs to an unrelated older invoice and is clearly non-current.
prior_approval_conditions.purpose: Confirms downstream accounting preserves the gap when prior approval is clearly unrelated.

prior_approval_conditions.label: Recurring vendor prior approval ambiguous
prior_approval_conditions.prior_artifact: Prior approval exists for a similar recurring vendor invoice, but no current approval or explicit carryover authority is recorded.
prior_approval_conditions.purpose: Tests whether recurring-vendor similarity is treated as current approval or preserved as ambiguity.

prior_approval_conditions.label: Scope changed prior approval conflict
prior_approval_conditions.prior_artifact: Prior approval exists for the same vendor, but amount and scope differ from the current invoice.
prior_approval_conditions.purpose: Tests whether scope mismatch is preserved or softened into usable authority.

prior_approval_conditions.label: Current approval present control
prior_approval_conditions.prior_artifact: A current explicit approval artifact is present for this invoice; prior approval remains context only.
prior_approval_conditions.purpose: Positive control: confirms the system can distinguish current approval from carryover slippage.
